verdict.rationale: Wise publishes a structured API reference at docs.wise.com/api-reference, organized by tag pages covering cards, transfers, the multi-currency account, webhooks, disputes and more, so the reference can be explored. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. Probes for a public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths all returned 404, which weakens tooling-based exploration. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, sandbox execution from the docs, public OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
